Hyderabad sees multiple fraud cases totaling over Rs 1.8 crore

Two separate fraud incidents have been reported in Hyderabad, involving a total loss of over Rs 1.8 crore. In one case, a degree student lost Rs 23 lakh to cyber fraud, while in another, a couple was booked for an alleged Rs 1.58 crore investment fraud. These incidents highlight ongoing financial crime concerns in the city.
